title: NODE — Industrial Drive, Mayfield

features.name: a storage container
features.desc-on-touch: Roller door, padlock, the particular cold of stored things. Opened years later.

features.name: a taped up cardboard box
features.desc-on-touch: Books. He rummaged anxiously until he found the one.

features.name: The Poems of Henry Kendall, 1991 pressing
features.desc-on-touch: Angus and Robertson. His father's copy, the one the poem was typed from. He took great care not to open it, or allow it to spontaneously fall open in front of him in any capacity.

features.name: a note about a cat in a box
features.desc-on-touch: The analogy was never offered as an explanation. It was a dismissal of somebody else's structural ontology. The book stays shut. Both words stay true.

inscription: the source exists and has not been consulted
